design: "Comfrey" — contextual learner of per-asset TACTIC PnL: K=8 shadow-run deterministic OHLC rules (trend-10/30/90 sign, 1d residual reversal, 5d xs reversal, 21d xs momentum, vol-targeted trend, constant-mix control) generate supervised targets y_{i,k,t} = [p_k·e_{t+1} − c|Δp_k|]/σ̂_YZ on the PIT 273-asset daily panel; one pooled LightGBM/ridge f(x, k) over ~30 OHLC-native features forecasts E[y|x]; predictions collapse to an asset-level residual forecast f_i, then a β-hedged Gârleanu–Pedersen partial-adjustment book (θ ∈ {0.25, 0.5}, no-trade band δ, turnover ≤ 0.06/day, entry if |f|σ̂/θ > 2c). Gates: K1 IC ≥ 0.02 on 2024-01→2026-06; K1' beats strategy-momentum baseline by 0.005; K1'' τ_IC ≥ 5 d; K2 net@21 ≥ +0.97 with CI lo > 0, N ≤ 6 configurations, SR0(N) printed. Claimed odds 5–7% for the goalposts.
lens: NO-FREE-LUNCH / ARITHMETIC — redo the IC / persistence / breadth / cost arithmetic at the mechanism's own turnover, check whether the profit source is honest, whether learning beats a closed-form estimator at the achievable SNR, and whether every gate can actually discriminate signal from bookkeeping and from the multiplicity null.
strongest_objection: At the design's own admitted gate values the book cannot pay for itself, so a PASS on K1 and K1'' does not imply K2 is reachable. K1 admits IC = 0.02 (m ≈ 0.02 σ-units → 8 bp/day of edge at σ̄ = 4%) and K1'' admits an IC e-folding time τ_IC = 5 days. A position whose edge decays exponentially with τ_IC = 5 d has a LIFETIME expected gross of m·σ̄·τ_IC = 8 bp × 5 = 40 bp, below its 42 bp round trip — it never breaks even with infinite patience. The design's "5.3-day break-even" assumed the edge holds at full strength for the whole hold; that is the wrong break-even. Generalising: for a book renewed every H days, cost drag in annual Sharpe = √365·√N_eff·2c/(H·σ̄) (independent of gross) = 7.2/H at N_eff = 10, σ̄ = 3.5%, while captured gross = 19.1·√N_eff·m·(τ_IC/H)(1 − e^{−H/τ_IC}) ≤ 1.21 at N_eff = 10, m = 0.02. With τ_IC = 5 d the net is negative at EVERY H (H = 5: 0.76 − 1.45; H = 10: 0.52 − 0.72; H = 20: 0.30 − 0.36; H = 30: 0.20 − 0.24). Solving net ≥ +0.97: τ_IC ≥ ~250–300 d at (IC 0.02, N_eff 10); ≥ ~55 d at (0.02, 20); ≥ ~30 d at (0.03, 10); ≥ ~16 d at (0.03, 20). The K1'' gate of 5 days is therefore 3–60× too lenient, and the design's central case (N_eff 10, IC 0.02) needs a signal that persists for roughly a quarter. A slow (weeks-to-quarter), cross-sectional, residual-return signal at IC ≥ 0.03 with breadth ≥ 20 is exactly TASK_915's h = 7/21 cell — the tactic transformation adds nothing to it and subtracts: it brings in the 1–5-day arms (k4, k5) that are unmonetisable by construction, it puts a KNOWN cost term inside the target that the model can learn from the |Δp| and log σ̂ features (per-date IC ≈ 0.028 for k1, ≈ 0.05 for k4 with zero return predictability — above the K1 threshold), it applies book-level cost again in the controller (double count) and turns the cost term into a spurious directional tilt of −Σ_k c|Δp_k|p_k/Σ|p_k| (≈ +0.05 σ-units of 1-day MOMENTUM from k4 alone, 2.5× the required m), and its Stage-0 stop ("ex-post oracle selector < +0.97 → stop") cannot fire because a per-(asset, day) oracle over arms including flat earns max_k(p_k e, 0) ≥ 0 every day.
arithmetic_check: 1. Units and bar: SR_d = 0.97/√365 = 0.0508; 0.56 → 0.0293 (`trader/backtest.py:128-138`, P = 365 for H = 1 d) — correct. 2. 819 calibration: cost 0.74 − 0.56 = 0.18 → 0.0094 SR_d = √N_eff·0.0021·0.152/0.04 → N_eff ≈ 1.4; gross 0.0387 = 1.18·m → m ≈ 0.033, ρ_30 ≈ 0.041, VR(30) − 1 ≈ 29·0.041/√30 ≈ 0.22 — arithmetic correct, but it calibrates the DIRECTIONAL market-trend component (one bet), which the β-hedge removes; it says nothing about residual autocorrelation. BULL24/CHOP25 gross +0.13/+0.22 (`POWERED_RESULT.md` RESULT table) → m ≈ 0.006–0.010, consistent with `CAPACITY_RESULT.md` "TSMOM sign30d" OOS IC −0.021 (H = 1) / +0.001 (H = 5) on 2024-07→2025-08. 3. Gross ceiling at K1: IR = IC·√BR·TC = 0.02·√(10·365)·1 = 1.21 (N_eff 10); 1.71 (N_eff 20). The bar leaves 0.24 (resp. 0.74) for cost AND transfer-coefficient loss; with TC ≈ 0.6 (memo §1.3) the K1 threshold consistent with K2 is IC ≈ 0.033 at N_eff 10, ≈ 0.025 at N_eff 20 — the design set K1 below what its own book needs. 4. Turnover ≠ cost control: τ = 2G/H for gross G renewed every H days; drag = √365·√N_eff·c·τ/(G·σ̄) = 19.1·√N_eff·2c/(H·σ̄) — G cancels. The design's 0.19 drag at τ = 0.06 corresponds to H ≈ 33 d at G = 1, i.e. positions held ~7× the K1'' persistence; TC over such a hold = (5/33)(1 − e^{−6.6}) ≈ 0.15 → gross 0.18 vs drag 0.22. 5. Persistence needed (full optimisation over H, m = 0.02, c = 21 bp, σ̄ = 3.5%): net(u = H/τ) = 19.1√N_eff·[m(1 − e^{−u}) − 2c/(σ̄τ)]/u; N_eff = 10 → τ_IC ≥ 293 d (H ≈ 0.22τ); N_eff = 20 → τ_IC ≥ 54 d; m = 0.03: τ_IC ≥ 31 d (N_eff 10), ≥ 16 d (N_eff 20). K1'' = 5 d admits signals whose lifetime gross (m·σ̄·τ = 40 bp) is below one round trip (42 bp). 6. Entry threshold |f| > 2cθ/σ̂: 0.026 (θ = 0.25) and 0.0525 (θ = 0.5) σ-units. A forecast with cross-sectional SD ≈ IC ≈ 0.02 around mean ≈ 0.008 exceeds 0.0525 on ≈ 1–3% of asset-days → the θ = 0.5 arm is flat by construction and fails the design's own ">50% flat = FAIL"; the θ = 0.25 arm enters on forecasts whose realised edge after estimation shrinkage (0.4–0.6, item 8) is ≈ 0.01–0.015 < the 0.026 it demanded. 7. Tactic-level turnover: k4 (−sign e_t) flips ~50% of days → E|Δp| ≈ 1.0/day → cost term 0.0021·1.0/0.04 = 0.0525 σ-units/day, requiring |ρ_1| ≥ 0.066 to break even inside its own target (typical residual daily lag-1 autocorrelation −0.02..−0.05 → mean target ≈ −0.02..−0.04: cost-dead). k5 (5d rank-z) ≈ 0.3–0.4/day. k1: 0.155/day → cost 0.008 σ-units (40% of the required m). 8. Effective sample and DoF budget: 2.8M "rows" are ~350k asset-days × 8 sign-copies of ONE noise draw e_{t+1}; mirror arms are exactly anticorrelated (zero information; "halving the noise" is false; the library's reversal arms are at L = 1, 5, not mirrors of trend-10/30/90 at all). Cross-sectional residual dependence (pairwise |ρ| ≈ 0.05–0.15 after one factor) caps independent observations per date at ~1/ρ̄ ≈ 7–20 → n_eff ≈ 1100 × 10 ≈ 11k for the first fit (25–60 live names, `POWERED_RESULT.md` coverage), ≈ 50k by the last. Signal variance at IC 0.02 = 4e-4 of target variance; ridge with P = 30: fitted-value noise P/n_eff = 2.7e-3 → 6e-4, so realised IC = IC_max·√(SNR·n/P/(1 + SNR·n/P)) ≈ 0.36–0.63 × IC_max; a GBM with min_leaf 2000 × 300 trees has effective DoF in the hundreds and is variance-dominated. The DoF budget n_eff·SNR ≈ 4–20 parameters: the interaction s(x_trend)·g(x_regime) is LINEAR in the features s_k ⊗ x_regime once the signs are known, so the closed-form ridge is the efficient estimator and no stated justification for GBM survives. 9. Learnable cost term: per-row cost = c|Δp_k|/σ̂_i is a deterministic function of features (|Δp_{i,k,t}|, log σ̂_YZ). Its cross-sectional SD: k1 = 0.105·√(0.0775·0.9225) ≈ 0.028; k4 ≈ 0.105·0.5 ≈ 0.052 → a model that predicts only the cost term scores per-date IC ≈ 0.028 (k1) / 0.05 (k4) against y with zero return predictability, clearing "IC ≥ 0.02, NW t ≥ 3" (SE of mean IC over ~900 dates ≈ 0.065/√900 ≈ 0.002 → t ≈ 13). The circular-shift placebo does not reproduce it (target shifted, feature not); only the sign-flip placebo does. 10. Multiplicity: E[max Z_N] = 1.27/1.63/1.95 for N = 6/12/24 (correct; N = 18 → 1.82, N = 54 → 2.31); σ_SR = 1/√T → SR0 = 0.80/1.03/1.23 (T = 2.5) and 0.60/0.77/0.92 (T = 4.5) — correct. But K1 selects among 18 cells × 3 seeds × 3 estimators (the meta-labeling arm is a third) before K2's 6; effective N ≈ 10–20 correlated trials → SR0 ≈ 1.0–1.2 on 2024–26, 0.75–0.9 on 2022–26; the +0.97 bar is inside the null on the primary span. "CI lo > 0" on 2.5 yr needs SR ≥ 1.96·√((1 + SR²/2)/T) → SR ≳ 1.5 (Lo 2002), i.e. above the mechanism's gross ceiling at K1 — the K2 pass as written is either inside the null or effectively "SR ≥ 1.5". 11. Range-ratio SE: q = σ²_Parkinson/σ²_CC; relative SE² = (0.26/√5.2)² + 0.26² → SE ≈ 0.28 on 30 bars, not 0.12 — the denominator dominates; the 5.2× Parkinson efficiency (Parkinson 1980; Garman–Klass 1980 7.4; Yang–Zhang 2000 ≤ 14 — prior knowledge, search-snippet depth) does not transfer to the ratio. q measures INTRADAY autocorrelation; the tactics harvest DAILY-lag (1–90 d) autocorrelation; the cross-scale link is an untested hypothesis (897 measured minute-scale xs autocorrelation decaying to IC 0.06 by 20 min). 12. k1 sign on RAW S_30 with a RESIDUAL payoff: under joint normality corr(sign S_raw, S_resid) = √(2/π)·√(1 − R²_mkt) ≈ 0.80 × 0.63 ≈ 0.50 at R² ≈ 0.6 → k1 keeps ~63% of a residual-trend arm's edge. 13. Break-even Sharpe geometry against the record: the framework reproduces the 819 book (m 0.033, N_eff 1.4, H ≈ 13 d, TC ≈ 1 → net@21 ≈ 0.56), so it is not biased against the design; the trend book worked because its signal outlived its holding period and its per-unit vol was the full 4%. Literature numbers used: Grinold–Kahn IR = IC·√BR·TC (textbook); Bailey–Borwein–López de Prado–Zhu 2014 E[max] (recomputed); Lo 2002 SE(SR) (prior knowledge). Cederburg et al. 2020 (8/103) and Ehsani–Linnainmaa 2022 (1 vs 53 bp/month) are US-equity, monthly, gross-of-cost factor studies — not re-verified here and not informative about daily per-asset crypto tactic-PnL persistence.
profit_source_check: The label is honest as far as it goes — a first-moment forecast (E[s·e|x]) dressed as a second-moment quantity via Dao et al.'s identity; the design admits the iterated-expectations identity is not escaped. But four of its five operative pieces are forecasts in disguise of things already measured or arithmetically dead: (a) k1's unconditional 2024–26 level is measured ≈ 0 (LEDGER `898/trend-decay`: 2024 +0.041, 2025 +0.663, 2026H1 −1.659 net@8; `CAPACITY_RESULT.md` TSMOM sign30d OOS IC −0.021/+0.001) and the mechanism relies on an unmeasured cross-sectional DISPERSION around that zero that must exceed 2–3× the historical mean and persist for weeks-to-a-quarter; (b) k5/k6 are daily market-neutral cross-sectional books — the object class 816's H = 1440 cells measured gross-negative (full64 −2.16, clean33 −3.33 CI[−6.03, −0.38], `runs/816_operating_point/PHASE1_RESULT.md`; minute-lag features, so a prior, not a falsification); (c) k4 is cost-dead inside its own target (needs |ρ_1| ≥ 0.066); (d) the β-hedge removes the market-trend component that carried the record's ONLY measured positive (BEAR22 short leg +1.095 vs long-flat −2.471, row 898), so the design's "calibration against the record" (m ≈ 0.033, VR(30) ≈ 1.2) is a calibration of the wrong quantity and there is no positive prior for the residual one; (e) any K1 pass on a single tactic target is partly bookkeeping — the learnable cost term alone produces IC ≈ 0.028–0.05. The "cost reduction" disclaimer is right in spirit, but the turnover budget is not a cost control at all (drag is gross-invariant; the lever is holding period vs persistence), and the design's stated 0.19 drag presumes 33-day holds of a 5-day signal. Risk-premium leakage via dollar-volume/size (Liu–Tsyvinski–Wu) is acknowledged but the by-feature-group attribution cannot separate it from a forecast when both load on the same features. What remains honest and unmeasured: "OHLC state predicts the sign and magnitude of RESIDUAL autocorrelation at lags 10–90 d with ≥ 50-day persistence and breadth ≥ 20" — a slow cross-sectional residual signal, which is TASK_915's h = 7/21 cell with sign-interacted features, not a separate mechanism.

surviving_mechanism: Not a lane and not a learner: ONE additional pre-registered cell block inside TASK_915, costing minutes on top of it. Target = GROSS market-residual, Yang–Zhang-standardised forward return at h ∈ {7, 21} plus h = 63 (to test the ≥ 50-day persistence the arithmetic requires), with the tactic cost kept OUT of the target and charged once, in the controller. Features = 915's F1–F3 plus a sign-interacted block s_L(t) ⊗ x_regime for L ∈ {30, 90} where s_L is the sign of the RESIDUAL L-day return (so arm and payoff match), and the per-asset trailing tactic-PnL mean (strategy momentum) as one ridge column. Estimator = ridge only (closed form, P ≈ 60–90, the DoF budget allows nothing larger); GBM, meta-labeling and the 1–5-day arms are dropped. Statistics = 915's per-date IC with NW t, both dependence-preserving placebos (the sign-flip one is mandatory because it is the only one that would expose a learnable deterministic term), the measured N_eff from the residual correlation spectrum (closing TASK_825's parked item), and the IC autocorrelation τ_IC with a persistence gate DERIVED from the goalpost at the measured N_eff (τ_IC ≥ ~55 d at N_eff 20 / IC 0.02; ≥ ~30 d at IC 0.03 / N_eff 10; ≥ ~250 d at IC 0.02 / N_eff 10), not a fixed 5 days. Stage 0 from the tactics panel (best FIXED mixture over the 8 rules, minutes) stays as a reported hull number, not as a stop. If that cell passes, the controller is 915's GP book with H (or θ, δ) pre-registered against the measured τ_IC; the deployable artifact is then two rules + one ridge vector + three controller constants — the design's controllability claim survives in that reduced form.
kill_experiment_critique: (1) K1 is passable by bookkeeping: the target contains c|Δp_k|/σ̂_i, a deterministic function of the features |Δp_{i,k,t}| and log σ̂_YZ; a model that learns only that term scores per-date IC ≈ 0.028 (k1) / ≈ 0.05 (k4) with NW t ≫ 3, above the 0.02 threshold, with zero return predictability. The circular-shift placebo (targets shifted, features not) does not reproduce it; the block-Rademacher placebo does — so the gate's survival depends on one placebo being implemented exactly as described. Fix: gross target. (2) K1'' is mis-derived from a no-decay position break-even; with τ_IC = 5 d and 8 bp/day the lifetime gross (40 bp) is below one round trip (42 bp). The persistence gate must be computed from the goalpost at the measured N_eff (≈ 55 d at N_eff 20 / IC 0.02; ≈ 250–300 d at N_eff 10). (3) The Stage-0 stop uses the ex-post oracle selector, which cannot fall below +0.97; the discriminating stop is the best fixed mixture (tactics panel row 1). (4) BEAR22 is not out of sample (regime starts 2021-11-10, `trader/config.py:74`) and the first fit has ≈ 10k effective observations; the BEAR22 clause therefore tests the fixed B0 blend (trend-short in 2022), not the learner. (5) The θ = 0.5 controller arm is flat by construction (entry threshold 0.0525 σ-units vs a forecast SD ≈ 0.02) and fails the design's own >50%-flat FAIL — a dead configuration that still counts toward N. (6) Multiplicity is undercounted: 18 cells × 3 seeds × 3 estimators (meta-labeling is a third) feed K2's 6; effective N ≈ 10–20 → SR0 ≈ 1.0–1.2 on 2024–26 and 0.75–0.9 on 2022–26, so +0.97 on the primary span is inside the null; and "CI lo > 0" on 2.5 yr requires SR ≳ 1.5 (SE ≈ 0.77), above the mechanism's gross ceiling at K1 — the K2 criteria are either inside the null or far stricter than stated, and the SPEC should print the effective bar. (7) "Turnover ≤ 0.06/day" is not a cost control (drag is gross-invariant, = √365·√N_eff·2c/(H·σ̄)); pre-register the holding period/θ/δ against the measured τ_IC instead. (8) k1's sign is computed on RAW S_30 but paid on RESIDUAL e — attenuation ≈ √(1 − R²_mkt) ≈ 0.63; make every arm residual-consistent. (9) The range-ratio feature's claimed SE (0.12) is wrong for a ratio (≈ 0.28, denominator-dominated) and it measures intraday autocorrelation, not the daily-lag autocorrelation the arms harvest; pre-register it as a hypothesis, not as a "5× efficient VR". (10) Mirror arms add zero information (exact anticorrelation of targets); the library's reversal arms are at L = 1, 5 and are cost-dead (k4 needs |ρ_1| ≥ 0.066) or unmonetisable at any turnover the controller permits — they add rows and multiplicity, not information. (11) `cell_metrics` REGIMES end 2025-09-01 and lack 2026H1; the SPEC must pin the custom regime list and the 899 backfill seam or the gated numbers cannot be emitted by an "unmodified" scorer. (12) The K1' comparison (learner vs strategy-momentum B0) is decided by variance at SNR 4e-4 with n_eff ≈ 10–50k: B0 has SE ≈ 0.10 σ-units per asset against a 0.02 signal and the GBM is variance-dominated; the informative comparison is ridge-with-sign-interactions vs ridge-without inside 915, not GBM vs B0.
odds_after_refutation: As specified (K1 = 0.02, K1'' = 5 d, N_eff 10 central case, cost inside the target, 8 arms, oracle stop, θ ∈ {0.25, 0.5}): P(K2 ≥ +0.97 by real edge) ≈ 0 — the gates admit signals that cannot pay for themselves, so any K2 pass on 2024–26 is more likely the multiplicity null (SR0 ≈ 1.0–1.2) than edge; P(a K1 'pass') is inflated by the learnable cost term and is uninformative. For the corrected, narrowest version (one 915 cell block: gross residual target, sign-interacted ridge, τ_IC gate derived from measured N_eff): P(IC ≥ 0.03 sustained on 2024-01→2026-06, placebo-clean) ≈ 8–10% (shared with 915's own prior, slightly below it because the residual autocorrelation has no positive record prior); P(τ_IC ≥ 50 d | that) ≈ 25%; P(N_eff ≥ 20 | ...) ≈ 30%; P(K2 | all) ≈ 40% → unconditional P(goalposts +0.97 PIT, 3 seeds, bear-positive, holds positions) ≈ 1–2%; P(≥ +0.56 MARGINAL) ≈ 3–5%. That is at or below the tactics panel's 3–5%, not above it — the target transformation and pooling are not the efficiency gain the design claims (the interaction is linear given known signs; mirror arms carry no information; the DoF budget forbids the GBM), and the FAIL branch's value ("retires every selector over daily deterministic tactics") is already delivered by 915 G-A plus the tactics panel's fixed-mixture hull.
